verdict.rationale: Notte's pricing table lists "Bring your own keys" as Yes only on the higher tiers, which suggests you can supply your own LLM provider keys but is gated by plan. The OpenAI CUA, CrewAI and Vercel AI SDK integrations show external agents using any model can drive Notte browsers. That is adjacent: it is not proof that Notte's own agent is model-agnostic. Missing for 10: documentation of which LLM providers and models Notte's agent supports, how to configure a custom provider, BYOK on all tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
